start_here: Say to your AI: "Hand in my answer to the choose step of run ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1: I chose the format row sample-map-short from my sample_formats table." It runs tool:submit-a-step-that-slots-rows with {"run": "ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1", "step": "choose", "answer": {"chosen": [{"row": "sample-map-short", "type": "sample_formats"}]}, "rows_of": "sample_formats"} and answers {"status": "kept", "answer_id": "ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1#answer:choose", "checks": [{"kind": "slotted-runs", "says": "Each chosen row ran its own workflows", "passed": true}], "unchecked": []} once the format's own workflow workflow:sample-voice-it has finished as this step's sub-run.
no_lists_because: It names no list of its own: it reads the one table of yours its caller names in rows_of, and keeps only its own ai_job rows in your own database.
instructions: 1. Give each row of your list the workflows it runs, in a field of its own (for example workflows: ["workflow:sample-voice-it"]); a row with none is refused by name.

2. When a step with a slotted-runs check chose rows, start each chosen row's workflow with tool:start-a-recipe-run, row set to the workflow and request key <run>:<step>:slot:<row id>, and finish that sub-run's steps.
3. Say to your AI: "Hand in my answer to that step", giving run, step, answer (each chosen row's id and type) and rows_of (the table the rows are kept in, for example sample_formats).
4. Read what comes back: kept, or the rows whose sub-runs have not finished, each named by its sub-run id.

worked_examples.title: A chosen format row whose own workflow finished is kept
worked_examples.ask: Hand in my answer to the choose step: I chose sample-map-short.
worked_examples.given: The run ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1, the format row sample-map-short naming workflow:sample-voice-it, and that workflow's sub-run ai-job:workflow:sample-voice-it:ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1:choose:slot:sample-map-short with its one step kept.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered {"status": "kept", "answer_id": "ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1#answer:choose", "checks": [{"kind": "slotted-runs", "says": "Each chosen row ran its own workflows", "passed": true}], "unchecked": []}, and kept ai-job:workflow:sample-piece:k1#answer:choose.
